name: Yauhen's Android apps
description: Personal Android apps: Wahoo Share, Weather Widget, Wallet and DeskLink.

apps.name: Wahoo Share
apps.summary: Send locations and cycling routes to your Wahoo ELEMNT
apps.description: Share locations and cycling routes with Wahoo ELEMNT. Find nearby water, toilets, bicycle repair, cafes and shops. Requires the Wahoo companion app for forwarding destinations.

apps.name: Weather Widget
apps.summary: Rain and weather forecasts on your home screen
apps.description: Home-screen weather widget showing rain and weather forecasts. Requires a reachable weather server; the default is https://weather.yauhen.cc. Configure the server and location when adding the widget.

apps.name: Wallet
apps.summary: Loyalty cards, vouchers, tickets and boarding passes, one tap away
apps.description: Keeps loyalty cards, vouchers, gift cards, event tickets and boarding passes on the phone and shows any code at full brightness in one tap. Reads codes from the camera, screenshots, PDF tickets and Apple Wallet passes; groups tickets and passengers; shows what is coming up. Live gate, delay and baggage belt information for boarding passes comes from flightstats.com, with no account or key.

apps.name: DeskLink
apps.summary: Your GNOME desktop on the tablet, with keyboard, trackpad and S-Pen
apps.description: Shows a Fedora GNOME desktop on an Android tablet over the LAN or a VPN, decoded in hardware (AV1 or 10-bit HEVC) at up to 120 frames a second, and sends the tablet's keyboard, mouse, touch trackpad gestures and S-Pen to it. Requires desklinkd running on the desktop (RPMs at github.com/jsnjack/desklink/releases); pair once by scanning the QR code from desklinkd pair.
